comment: Manual read at https://flagaudio.com/vcv/prince-of-perception.html, which gives the 2ms to 20 seconds delay range, the 40 second scan, the -5V to 5V CV ranges, the sidechain normalling and every menu item. The manual calls the module Prism Of Perception twice in its own text, in the FRZ and SCN paragraphs; the panel and the plugin both say Prince Of Perception, and the entry follows the panel. Input 3 is declared in the code with no widget and no panel position, so it can never be clicked and has no line, tag or family.
